full_prompt_en: A square oil landscape shows a broad golden-brown marsh beneath a vast, cloud-filled sky, with a narrow reflective channel entering from the lower center. The horizon sits below the middle of the painting, leaving most of the frame to the heavy atmosphere. Across the upper left, dark slate-gray cloud masses rise and spread into fine, wind-swept layers. Near the upper center, a pale break in the cloud cover lets muted yellow light glow through uneven edges, while the far right remains veiled in cooler gray. Beneath that expansive sky, the level fields extend toward a thin, dark horizon with a few distant tree shapes. The land is divided into low bands of ocher, straw yellow, and umber. A rough watercourse begins near the bottom edge, bends gently through dark grassy banks, and narrows as it travels toward the center distance. Its shallow surface reflects a small, bright piece of sky close to the foreground, so the luminous patch becomes a quiet visual anchor amid the dark reeds. Taller clumps of brown and olive grass frame the channel on both sides, their thin strokes visibly separating from the flatter fields behind. On the right side near the horizon, a compact dark group of trees stands beside a small brown-roofed building. The building is partly absorbed by the shade and remains secondary to the sky and open ground. There are no visible people or readable marks. Light is diffuse and filtered through the broken clouds, warming the grass and glancing off the water while leaving broad cloud undersides and foreground banks in subdued shadow. Fine brush marks and soft scumbling give the clouds a layered vaporous density; drier, shorter strokes make the grass uneven and tactile. The distance loses contrast gradually, though the small dark tree group still gives the open field a point of scale. The overall composition is spacious and restrained, setting a tiny human structure within a much larger play of weather, water, and muted earth colors.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画风景呈现广阔的金褐色沼泽与巨大的布云天空，一条狭窄反光水道从下部中央进入画面。地平线位于画幅中点下方，把大部分空间留给厚重的大气。左上方，深石板灰色云团升起，并展开成细密、被风扫过的层次。上部中央附近，云层的一处浅色裂隙让低调的黄色光从参差边缘透出，最右侧仍笼罩在较冷的灰色中。广阔天空下，平坦田野延伸至细细的深色地平线，那里有几处遥远的树形。土地分成低矮的赭色、麦秆黄与深褐色带。一条粗粝水道从底缘附近开始，在深色草岸间轻轻弯转，向中央远处逐渐收窄。浅浅水面在前景附近反射一小块明亮天空，使发光之处成为深色芦草中的安静视觉锚点。较高的棕色和橄榄色草丛立于水道两侧，纤细笔触与后方较平坦的田地清楚分开。右侧地平线附近，一组紧凑的深色树木立在一幢棕色屋顶小建筑旁。建筑部分被阴影吸收，相对于天空和开阔地面保持次要。画中没有可见人物或可读标记。光穿过破开的云层漫射下来，温暖草地并擦亮水面，同时让大片云底和前景河岸保持低调阴影。细微笔痕与柔软擦涂让云层具有层叠的雾气密度；更干、更短的笔触令草地参差而可触。远处对比逐渐消失，不过小小的深色树群仍为开阔田野提供尺度。整体构图宽广而克制，把微小的人造结构置于更宏大的天气、水面与低调大地色变化之中。
style_prompt_en: The oil-painted surface is built from broad atmospheric color masses and small, irregular strokes that become more distinct near the lower edge. Slate gray, olive brown, ocher, and faded straw dominate, while narrow openings of warm cream light interrupt the cooler darks. Layered scumbling makes upper areas feel deep and vaporous; drier broken marks produce a coarse, tactile lower band. A low horizontal division grants generous space to slowly shifting tonal forms. One sinuous, brighter passage cuts through the darker lower area and draws the eye toward a thin, softened distance. Compact dark accents sit near that distant line and supply scale without competing with the expansive tonal field. Light is filtered and directional enough to make selective reflections, yet shadows remain soft and broad. Edge contrast decreases toward the distance, unifying the layers in a humid atmosphere. The overall effect is contemplative and spacious, with weathered paint and subtle light breaks supplying the drama.
style_prompt_zh: 油画表面由宽阔的大气色团与细小不规则笔触构成，后者在靠近下缘处更加清晰。石板灰、橄榄褐、赭色与褪色麦秆色占主导，狭窄的暖奶油色光隙打断较冷的深色。层叠擦涂让上部区域显得深厚而雾气弥漫；更干、更破碎的痕迹形成粗粝可触的下部色带。偏低的水平分割把宽裕空间交给缓慢变化的明度形态。一条蜿蜒而较亮的色带穿过较暗的下部区域，带领视线走向细薄、柔化的远处。紧凑的深色重音落在那条远线附近，提供尺度，却不与广阔的明度色域争夺注意。光受到过滤，仍有足够方向性留下局部反射，而阴影保持柔软宽阔。边缘对比朝远处递减，使各层融入潮湿的大气。整体效果沉思而开阔，风化感的颜料和微妙光隙提供主要戏剧性。
theme_en: A broad marsh beneath layered clouds and a distant farmhouse
theme_zh: 层叠云天与远处农舍下的广阔沼泽
name: John Crome
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
